messages:
alex: Uploading the new Llama2-70B checkpoint to s3 and starting safetensors conversion. Path: s3://redwood-models/llama2/70b/raw/2026-03-15/

mira: Thanks. what's TP and dtype we want for hosted? Also tokenizer compatibility?

alex: Target: TP=8 layout (our runtime uses interleaved TP shards), convert to safetensors sharded by 2GB. Dtype: prefer bf16 for Dedicated, fallback fp16 for some customers. Tokenizer: upstream uses `tokenizer.json` + `vocab.txt`; we need to generate `tokenizer.model` for sentencepiece wrapper.

jonathan: Noted re tokenizer. Any special trimming of metadata? Last time the `bos_token` was missing and validate_model crashed.

alex: Good call. I added a small transform in the script to ensure `bos_token_id` and `eos_token_id` exist. See snippet:
```
# ensure tokenizer keys
tok = json.load(open(tok_path))
if 'bos_token_id' not in tok:
  tok['bos_token_id'] = tok.get('cls_token_id', 1)
```
Also patching `model_index.json` -> `config.json` mapping.

luis: CI noticed the conversion PR fails on safeheader checks — convert-bot flagged mismatched tensor shapes. @alex can you paste the convert log?

convert-bot: conversion started for s3://redwood-models/llama2/70b/raw/2026-03-15/ -> s3://redwood-models/llama2/70b/packed/2026-03-15/
convert-bot: ERROR: shard_01.safetensors: unexpected dim0 (expect 128 but got 64) in `lm_head.weight`

alex: That's probably due to TP layout mismatch. I accidentally used TP=4 during export. Re-running with --tp 8 now. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4921

mira: Can you also include the validation harness command in the PR? E.g.:
```
python infra/validate_model.py --model s3://redwood-models/llama2/70b/packed/2026-03-15/ --expected-seqlen 2048 --check-tokenizer
```

alex: Added those tests. Also added a small script to reconstruct shards locally for inspection: `scripts/reconstruct_shards.py --input-dir ./shards --out consolidated.safetensors`

jonathan: FYI perf note: bf16 inference on A100s gives ~8% throughput uplift vs fp16 for this backbone. Might be worth recommending bf16 as default in model profile.

luis: Security: make sure S3 ACL is private and the presigned URLs expire. Devops, can you check bucket policy?

devops: Checking. Bucket already has restricted access from the inference role, presigned urls default 15m. Will tighten if needed.

alex: One remaining ask: @mira can you review code and the packaging conventions? PR #4921 includes `shard-layout.md` doc. Small deadline: want to promote to staging today EOD.

mira: Will review in a bit :eyes: If it's green CI and tokenizer validation passes, I'm fine with staging.

ci-bot: build/test runtime #4921 — tests: 128 passed, 3 flaky skipped — conversion pipeline: OK — packaging lint: 1 warning

alex: thanks all :white_check_mark: I'll re-run conversion with correct TP and push new shards.

luis: ping if you want me to run quick local decoding smoke tests.

alex: will do, thanks!
